title: Desktop Coder start fails: "the granted source snapshot is unavailable or changed"
body: A desktop Coder start can fail with “the granted source snapshot is unavailable or changed” even when its source is readable and within the admitted entry and byte limits. A source tree with many sibling directories reproduces an incomplete observation caused by exhausting the process's open-file limit. Fix source observation so a wide tree can be completely observed within its resource budget. Preserve the existing no-follow boundary for links, completeness reporting, entry and byte limits, and change detection. Add a focused regression test. Work within the source-observation and admission code needed for this behavior; do not weaken admission to accept an incomplete snapshot.
